stances.quote: Today, Congressman Dave Joyce (OH-14) voted in favor of the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) for Fiscal Year 2027 (FY27). This legislation, which passed the House, takes significant steps to revitalize our defense industrial base while improving the quality of life of our service members and military families.
stances.reasoning: The statement explicitly supports voting for the NDAA which revitalizes the defense industrial base.
No position stated on government spending.
No position stated on trade policy.
No position stated on foreign aid.
